env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/defer_indexed_callee.lgo main.lgo
cp main.lgo original.lgo.txt
logos run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/defer_indexed_callee.out
logos eject -o out
cmp main.lgo original.lgo.txt
exists out/main.go
cd out
go run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/defer_indexed_callee.out
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/defer_indexed_callee.out
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1273/bin/go run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/defer_indexed_callee.out
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l main.go
! stdout .

module example.com/deferindexed

go 1.27
